# Rollout And Pricing Path

## Caption

Start with a free self-hosted registry. Add managed workflows, deployment support, and enterprise governance when agent capabilities become company infrastructure.

#OpenSource #SaaS #DeveloperTools #AIInfrastructure #PlatformEngineering #DevEx #Intertool

## Alt Text

1. Start free. Scale when governance matters. Intertool pricing follows the way engineering teams adopt internal platforms.
2. $0 self-hosted registry. For individuals and small teams standardizing local agent workflows.
3. $199/month plus seats. Managed hosting, org paths, review queue, audit log, and onboarding.
4. $3k+ annual support. Private deployment help, governance setup, security review, and upgrades.
5. Custom for regulated teams. Policy design, procurement support, retention requirements, and rollout planning.
6. Choose the path that matches your rollout. Deploy self-hosted today or compare plans when the registry becomes infrastructure.
